messages.content: 去年現代藝術博物館的會員們有多頻繁地參觀？

function.name: most_frequent_visitor
function.description: Retrieve the visitor who visited the museum the most within a given period. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

start_date.description: The start date of the period, format: yyyy-mm-dd.

end_date.description: The end date of the period, format: yyyy-mm-dd.

minimum_visits.description: The minimum number of visits to qualify. Default: 1

We need to retrieve the visitor who visited the museum the most within a given period. But the question is about frequency of visits by members. But the question is plural: "會員們" (members). So maybe they want the average visits per member. But the function only gives the most frequent visitor. We could call the function with museum_name "現代藝術博物館", start_date "2023-01-01", end_date "2023-12-31". That will return the most frequent visitor. But maybe we can assume that the most frequent visitor is a member. But not guaranteed.

However, we can interpret as "most frequent visitor" and provide that. The function signature includes optional minimum_visits default 1. We can set minimum_visits to 1. So we call the function.

Thus we will call the function with museum_name "現代藝術博物館", start_date "2023-01-01", end_date "2023-12-31". Then we will output the result.
